text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Meow. Meoow. ...Woof, ruff-ruff. Woof, 
meow... woof.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Are ya a cat, or a dog? Actually... 
what have you even been doing this whole 
time?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A pet. You mentioned before that you 
wanted to keep one, right? So, as a 
birthday present...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're being serious right now, 
even I can't cover for ya."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I-I know! I'm not a pet! But birthdays are 
very important. I just really wanted to 
celebrate it with you...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Tama would probably tell me, 
"Save that money instead of celebrating." 
So, I thought really hard about it, and...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...And that's how we ended up with this 
bizarre behavior. *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Cat, dog, whatever, it still eats food, 
right? Today, you're treating me to 
whatever you recommend.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...! Yeah, it's my treat, let's go! Ah, 
wait, no! Meow-woof!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So which one is it, then?! ...Dummy.
